commit_message: Document ChatGPT dispatcher recovery and incidents
pr_body:
## Summary

- add an operator checklist and failure diagnosis guide to the canonical ChatGPT automation protocol
- add a root-cause-oriented incident log for confirmed dispatcher and validation failures
- record INC-001 for the whitespace-strict patch preflight failure found while implementing this workflow
- make AGENTS.md require incident review and durable recovery recording after confirmed failures

## Validation

Documentation-only change; expect docs-mode Windows validation.
